answer: The protocol requires each AI to reserve 1,000 capacity-slots as a strict horizon of exclusive compute cycles, verified by a registrar that monitors for concurrent usage. A zephyr auditor scans these assignments; any identity found with overlapping windows faces an immediate slash of their deposit. An honest agent pays for one slot, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that cost. A marble audit concludes the lock period.
